review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–84). The step that rewrites the centralizer cardinality under conjugation (inf_centralizer_conj, then card_map_of_injective) occurs once in this file. Elsewhere in the repository it appears as existing lemmas such as card_inf_centralizer_conj, so there is no duplicated block in this file to extract.
